section: Product autonomy model — reuses P8, no second brain

source_of_truth.engine: src/lib/pierre/v1/autonomy.ts decideValidation (P8, read-only import) — the authoritative policy engine
source_of_truth.company_setting: pierre_rt_companies.default_autonomy_mode (P8 column) — single source of truth, read/written via V1 GET/PATCH /company
source_of_truth.capability_gates: hr-canon HrAutonomyLevel + HrImplementationStatus (HUMAN_ONLY / LEGAL_CONTENT_REQUIRED / EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY) + evaluateCapabilityGate

framing: Pierre — votre employé IA RH / votre équipe RH opérationnelle (jamais assistant/copilote)

product_modes.label: Exécution contrôlée
product_modes.tagline: Pierre exécute le travail autorisé, demande pour le risqué.

product_modes.label: Autonomie gouvernée
product_modes.tagline: Pierre opère la RH en continu, dans vos règles.

engine_mode_coverage: the 5 product modes cover all 4 real P8 AutonomyMode values (governed + dirigeant share enterprise_autonomous; the difference is the supervision framing, not the engine behavior)

matrix_is_derived_not_cosmetic.how: deriveAutonomyMatrix(mode) calls the REAL decideValidation for each representative P8 ActionKind (14 actions across the risk/sensitivity spectrum) and buckets by the returned ValidationDecision. No HR logic is reimplemented.

hard_floors_proven.claim: restricted / approval-required (contract, amendment, compensation, sanction, termination, dismissal, sensitive_medical, harassment_flagged, final_recruitment_decision) are NEVER auto-executed (never 'alone'/'notify') in ANY of the 5 modes — including governed/dirigeant

modes_change_behavior_proven.effective_autonomy_monotonic: count(alone+notify) strictly increases draft < validation ≤ controlled ≤ governed
